claims.claim: On 30 September, Flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv diverted to Saudi Arabia after a cockpit incident in which one pilot allegedly stabbed the other.
claims.episode_span: Flydubai flight FZ1073, travelling from Dubai to Tel Aviv, diverted to Saudi Arabia after one pilot allegedly stabbed the other
claims.source_title: Wong thanks ‘heroes’ who thwarted flydubai pilot’s alleged attack on co-pilot as Australians confirmed safe
claims.supporting_quote: The flydubai aircraft was travelling from the United Arab Emirates to Israel when it was forced to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia.

claims.claim: During the alleged attack the plane plunged about 17,000 feet in two minutes.
claims.episode_span: the aircraft plunged about 17,000 feet in two minutes
claims.source_title: Wong thanks ‘heroes’ who thwarted flydubai pilot’s alleged attack on co-pilot as Australians confirmed safe
claims.supporting_quote: During the alleged attack, the plane plunged about 17,000 feet in just two minutes .

claims.episode_span: Israeli officials said the accused pilot was an Omani citizen
claims.source_title: Wong thanks ‘heroes’ who thwarted flydubai pilot’s alleged attack on co-pilot as Australians confirmed safe
claims.supporting_quote: One of the pilots, whom Israeli officials said was an Omani citizen, is accused of stabbing his co-pilot.

claims.claim: Passenger Yaniv Hayoun said he put the attacker in a chokehold and dragged him from the cockpit, and that the attacker was trying to destroy the instruments.
claims.episode_span: he put the attacker in a chokehold and dragged him from the cockpit, saying the man was trying to destroy the instruments
claims.source_title: Wong thanks ‘heroes’ who thwarted flydubai pilot’s alleged attack on co-pilot as Australians confirmed safe
claims.supporting_quote: “I grabbed the attacker, put him in a chokehold, and dragged him out first,” Hayoun said during a meeting with Netanyahu after the plane had landed safely and the passengers were flown to Israel.

claims.claim: The BBC identified the stabbed pilot as Indian captain Smit Machchhar.
claims.episode_span: the BBC named the stabbed pilot as Indian captain Smit Machchhar
claims.source_title: Who is the 'hero' Indian pilot who was stabbed on Israel-bound flight?
claims.supporting_quote: Capt Smit Machchhar was attacked by another pilot onboard the Flydubai flight bound for Tel Aviv.

claims.claim: Israel's prime minister hailed the Indian pilot.
claims.episode_span: whom Israel’s prime minister hailed
claims.source_title: Israel PM hails Indian pilot of rerouted flight for averting disaster
claims.supporting_quote: Israel PM hails Indian pilot of rerouted flight for averting disaster

claims.claim: Flydubai suspended flights to and from Israel while the investigation continues and said the motive remains unclear.
claims.episode_span: flights to and from Israel are suspended while the investigation continues and that the motive remains unclear
claims.source_title: US says 4 Americans were aboard FlyDubai flight diverted to Saudi Arabia
claims.supporting_quote: “Following the incident involving flight FZ1073 on 30 September, and in coordination with the relevant authorities, FlyDubai flights to and from Israel will be suspended while the investigation continues,” a FlyDubai spokesperson said.

claims.claim: Netanyahu said Israel had information that Iran's proxies were planning attacks but no specific warning about this incident, and that it was too early to say who was behind it.
claims.episode_span: no specific warning about this flight, and that it was too early to say who was behind it
claims.source_title: Netanyahu: Israel received no specific warning ahead of Flydubai incident
claims.supporting_quote: 'What we had information that Iran's proxies were planning attacks,' Netanyahu told CNN's Jim Sciutto, adding, 'But I can't tell you that we had any specific warning about this'

claims.claim: Trump said he spoke with Netanyahu and described the co-pilot as perhaps a terrorist or a whack-job who stabbed the pilot.
claims.episode_span: the co-pilot “was perhaps a terrorist, or perhaps a whack-job, and he stabbed the pilot”
claims.source_title: US says 4 Americans were aboard FlyDubai flight diverted to Saudi Arabia
claims.supporting_quote: “It seems as though the co-pilot was perhaps a terrorist, or perhaps a whack-job, and he stabbed the pilot,” Trump said.

claims.claim: Israel's defence minister labelled the incident a thwarted terror attack.
claims.episode_span: Israel’s defence minister labelled the incident a thwarted terror attack
claims.source_title: Live: FlyDubai suspends flights to and from Israel after pilot attack
claims.supporting_quote: Israel’s defence minister has labelled the incident as a thwarted “terror attack”.

claims.claim: The US State Department said four Americans were aboard the diverted flight.
claims.episode_span: The US State Department said four Americans were aboard
claims.source_title: Four US citizens were aboard flydubai flight
claims.supporting_quote: The US State Department indicated that four Americans were aboard a flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv that was diverted to Saudi Arabia.

claims.claim: Penny Wong said at least two Australians on the flight are safe, and Israel's embassy in Australia said they are a Jewish couple from Sydney.
claims.episode_span: at least two Australians are safe
claims.source_title: Wong thanks ‘heroes’ who thwarted flydubai pilot’s alleged attack on co-pilot as Australians confirmed safe
claims.supporting_quote: Two Australian citizens onboard a flight to Tel Aviv that was diverted after one of the pilots allegedly stabbed the other in an attack are “safe,” the foreign minister confirmed.

claims.claim: Ambassador Hillel Newman described the incident as an attempt to hit the Abraham Accords, which normalised UAE-Israel relations in 2020.

claims.source_title: Wong thanks ‘heroes’ who thwarted flydubai pilot’s alleged attack on co-pilot as Australians confirmed safe
claims.supporting_quote: “It’s an attempt to hit at the peace itself, at the Abraham Accords, and the relationships which Israel does have with Arab and Muslim countries.”
